mixed order: skip done, re-handle grown.why: 'a' is not in seen, so the spec's skip rule does not apply: apply is called on it (its fallback only keeps it out of seen). The case skipped a new id.

duplicate ids in one run (unmatched): bo.why: The spec skips an id that is in seen; after the first copy is handled it is recorded, so the second copy is skipped (each message handled once). DeepSeek marked the case ambiguous; Gmail / chat.db ids are unique in one fetch anyway.
